newsitem.title: USA: WinStar sets plan with 10 pct trigger.
newsitem.headline: WinStar sets plan with 10 pct trigger.

text.p: WinStar Communications Inc said Wednesday tthat its board of directors has adopted a Stockholder Rights Plan.

When asked by Reuters whether the plan was adopted in response to a particular attempt to take control of the company, a spokeswoman said, "Our policy does not allow us to comment on those types of questions."
The rights will be exercisable only if certain persons or groups acquire or begin a tender offer for beneficial ownership of 10 percent or more of the company's outstanding common stock.
Under the plan, preferred stock purchase rights will be distributed as a dividend at the rate of one right for each share of common stock held as of the close of business on July 14, 1997.
